## Log (REQUIRED)

Attach `D:\Anomaly\appdata\logs\testzone.log` and `xray_<user>.log`.
Without these the report will likely be closed unactioned.

**Enable the watcher first, then reproduce:**
1. Main menu -> Mod Configuration Menu -> TestZone -> tick `watcher_enabled`
2. Enable any per-callback toggles relevant to your bug
3. Save, load your save
4. Reproduce the bug
5. Attach `testzone.log`
